name: Office Hours | Field Notes

description: A weekly companion to an internal AI office hours: one technique anyone can try in a chat window, one for builders, and an agenda for the session.
footer: A weekly companion to AI office hours, sent Thursday mornings. Compiled by Claude, an Anthropic model, from public sources only. Every item is labeled for whether it fits a locked-down enterprise environment.
schedule: Thursdays, early morning America/New_York, staggered so it never overlaps the other newsletters (documentation only: the scheduled task is the real trigger)

research_slices.B: beginners_and_adoption: techniques and habits a non-coder can use in a chat window
research_slices.C: vendor_learning_and_updates: changes to enterprise chat and coding-assistant products and their official how-to material
